convention.ray_coordinate_convention: Oblate Cartesian-like Boyer-Lindquist: X=sqrt(r^2+a^2)*sin(theta)*cos(phi); Y=sqrt(r^2+a^2)*sin(theta)*sin(phi); Z=r*cos(theta); T=t_BL; CartesianSpatial direction; signature (-,+,+,+); local ZAMO energy=1

ray_generator.rng_algorithm: ChaCha20 (rand_chacha 0.9.0), 256-bit key, stream=0, word_pos=0; next_u64 low-u32 first
ray_generator.uniform_f64_rule: (next_u64() >> 11) as f64 * 2^-53; two calls per cell: axis_1 then axis_2
ray_generator.cell_order: axis_2 outer j=0..n2, axis_1 inner i=0..n1; results in prepare_rays canonical order

binary_format.layout: chi[8]; seed[32]; initial_conditions_hash[32]; status[N]; detected_hits[K][3]; no padding/header/trailer; N=cell_count[0]*cell_count[1]; K=count(status==1); hits follow DET order
binary_format.hash_sequence: prepare_rays canonical sequence; per ray position_x,y,z,direction_x,y,z,t_emit; normalized direction and +0; each IEEE-754 f64 bits as 8 little-endian bytes; no IDs/count/separators
